settings.heading: Description
settings.row_content:
A daily beauty supplement that puts PDRN and hydrolysed marine collagen peptides into a single berry jelly stick — no water, no shaker, no scoop. Vitamin C and hyaluronic acid round out the formula to support skin that looks hydrated, smooth and healthy.

The format is the point. A supplement only works if you actually take it, and a stick you can tear open at your desk survives a busy week in a way a tub of powder does not.

settings.heading: Who It's For
settings.row_content:
For anyone who wants to support their skin from the inside without adding another ten-minute step to the day — and for anyone who has bought collagen before and left it half-finished in a cupboard.

Take one stick daily. Most people look for a change in comfort and glow from around week four; give it a full 90 days for the complete effect. Individual results vary.

Not suitable for vegans, vegetarians, or anyone with a fish or shellfish allergy. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking medication, check with your doctor first. A food supplement is not a substitute for a varied diet.

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.row_content:
Orders are packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. You will get a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel leaves us.

  • Delivery: 15–30 days from dispatch.
  • Tracking: included on every order.
  • Orders over the free-shipping threshold ship free; the exact cost is shown at checkout before you pay.

Sticks are shelf-stable and need no refrigeration, so nothing spoils in transit. Delivery estimates exclude weekends and public holidays, and customs processing can add a few days on international orders.

settings.heading: Returns & Refunds
settings.row_content:
If it isn't right for you, email us within 30 days of delivery and we'll sort it out.

  • Unopened boxes: returned for a full refund.
  • Opened boxes: because this is a consumable, we can only accept these where the product is faulty or was damaged in transit.
  • Damaged, wrong or missing items: send us a photo and we replace or refund it — you keep the original.

Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days of us receiving the return. Return postage is on us for a faulty or incorrect order; otherwise it's the customer's to cover.

settings.heading: Skin Science, In A Single Stick
settings.text:
PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a DNA-derived active that Korean skin experts have leaned on for years to support the skin's own renewal process. We pair it with hydrolysed marine collagen peptides, vitamin C and hyaluronic acid — the supporting cast that helps your skin make the most of them.

No shaker, no clumps, no 30-second stirring ritual. Just tear, take, and get on with your day.

settings.title: PDRN Complex
settings.text: The hero active behind the stick, traditionally used in K-beauty to support a plumper, bouncier-looking complexion.

settings.title: Hydrolysed Marine Collagen
settings.text: Low-molecular-weight peptides, broken down small so they're easy for your body to take in day after day.

settings.title: Vitamin C
settings.text: Contributes to normal collagen formation for the normal function of skin — which is why it never travels alone in this formula.

settings.title: Hyaluronic Acid
settings.text: The moisture magnet. Works alongside collagen to keep skin feeling comfortable and looking dewy rather than tight.

settings.title: Not Your Average Collagen Powder
settings.text: Most collagen supplements ask you to find a shaker, a glass of water and two spare minutes. This one asks for ten seconds.

settings.heading: When should I take it?
settings.row_content: Whenever you'll actually remember — morning coffee, post-workout, or last thing at night. There's no water or food required, so pick the moment that's easiest to repeat daily.

settings.heading: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.row_content: Most people report skin feeling more hydrated within the first couple of weeks, with changes in smoothness and glow around week four. Give it a full 90 days for the complete ritual effect — individual results vary.

settings.heading: What does it taste like?
settings.row_content: A light berry jelly with no added sugar and no fishy aftertaste — the thing most people worry about with marine collagen, and the reason we formulated it this way.

settings.heading: Is it suitable for me?
settings.row_content: The collagen is marine-derived, so it isn't suitable for vegans, vegetarians, or anyone with a fish or shellfish allergy. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking medication, please check with your doctor before starting any supplement.

settings.heading: How do I store it?
settings.row_content: Keep the sticks somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sunlight. No refrigeration needed, which is exactly why they travel well.

settings.heading: When will my order arrive?
settings.row_content: Dispatched within 1–2 business days, delivered 15–30 days after that, with tracking on every order. Full detail is in the Shipping section further up the page.

settings.heading: What if it's not right for me?
settings.row_content: Email us within 30 days of delivery. Unopened boxes are refunded in full; opened ones we can take back if the product is faulty or arrived damaged. Refunds land back on your original payment method within 5–10 business days.
